title: Top exterior sheaf commutes with internal duality
statement: Let X be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], M a finite locally free sheaf of O_X-modules of constant natural rank d [def-amb-finite-locally-free-module], and M^dual = Hom(M,O_X) its internal dual [def-pur-sheaf-hom]. For the sheafified sectionwise exterior powers [def-sc-sheaf-exterior-power], there exists an isomorphism wedge^d(M^dual) ≅ Hom(wedge^d M,O_X) of ordinary sheaves of O_X-modules. No tensor product, derived category, shift, or extra hypothesis is involved.

source.place: Tag 0BRT, final determinant inversion: conormal determinant is inverse to normal determinant; the finite free determinant pairing is Mathlib/LinearAlgebra/ExteriorPower/Pairing.lean:64-74 and Basis.lean:bijective_pairingDual.

proof.text: Construct the exterior-dual morphism with its determinant formula in degree d, using lem-sc-exterior-dual-pairing-construction. This step has no finite local freeness hypothesis.

Unpack finite local freeness into a covering family of opens with free rank-d trivializations. On every subopen of every member, lem-sc-exterior-dual-pairing-local-bijective applied to the constructed morphism proves bijectivity on sections.

Apply the proved coversTop local injectivity and local surjectivity criteria to the underlying sheaf morphism. Sheaf.isLocallyBijective_iff_isIso gives its invertibility, and the forgetful functor SheafOfModules.toSheaf reflects isomorphisms. The asIso construction supplies the required Nonempty isomorphism. This is the explicit Lean assembly of the two parts and the standard sheaf criterion; no choice of data in a definition is involved.

lean.statement:
theorem exteriorSheaf_dual_iso (X : Scheme.{u}) (M : X.Modules) (d : ℕ)
    (hfree : M.IsFiniteLocallyFreeOfRank d) :
    Nonempty ((Scheme.Modules.exteriorSheaf
      (SheafOfModules.homObj (R := X.sheaf) M
        (SheafOfModules.unit X.ringCatSheaf)) d) ≅
      Scheme.Modules.dual (Scheme.Modules.exteriorSheaf M d))
